relationships.subject: ABK5
relationships.evidence_quote: The compound ABK5 is a CB2 selective agonist with CB2 Ki = 16 nM and no binding to CB1.

relationships.subject: ABK5
relationships.evidence_quote: ABK5 (10 μM) also reduced TNF-α mRNA (F(3,32) = 21.44, p < 0.0001; Fig. 3D) as well as protein (F(3,32) = 20.62, p < 0.0001; Fig. 3F).

relationships.subject: ABK5
relationships.evidence_quote: The IL-2 protein released to the culture medium showed the same effect: it was significantly decreased at 10 μM ABK5

relationships.subject: ABK5
relationships.evidence_quote: ABK5 also significantly increased the mechanical threshold that had been decreased by CFA treatment, suggesting its capability of ameliorating pain.

key_findings: CB2 agonist ABK5 reduced IL-2 and TNF-alpha production and CXCL12 chemotaxis in Jurkat T cells
ABK5 reduced paw edema and raised mechanical threshold in CFA rats but did not restore weight-bearing or locomotion
